findings.summary: Students sharing a display name receive identical roster headings and disclosure descriptions, leaving guardians unable to distinguish their accounts.
findings.fix: Use a human-readable unique identity such as `${s.name} (${s.username})` in each roster h3, keeping summaries/settings links described by that h3; use the same identity in progress status strings. Add a duplicate-name regression case.

Chrome AX shows both articles named 동명이인 and both 학습 현황 disclosures described only as 동명이인; neither roster card contains its username.
